The registered mount resolves somewhere other than the actual temporary checkout.
The store returns zero or multiple rows; ensures an empty instrument cannot claim success.
Persistence or the public resolver drops or changes the seeded revision, plan or section. These compare retrieved fixture values with supplied inputs and are not counted as repair coverage.
A live upstream pointer is present, which would bypass the promoted-only scenario.
Restore the flat plan fallback in _unloaded_sections: reachable brief promotions are reported unlanded; demonstrated for both carriers.
Treat an unreachable promotion as landed, e.g. ignore _revision_is_ancestor and remove its pending entry unconditionally.
Ignore ordinary flat-plan ledger identity so a reachable plan-dispatched promotion remains unloaded.

Restore the flat fallback: reachable cases return awaiting-upstream instead of queued; falsely treating unreachable revisions as landed fails the other two cases. Expected phase is derived from the independent git topology, not a phase supplied to resolve_waits.
